title: L & N Pro: Speech Practice
shortDescription: Hear L and N, practise a word, replay your pronunciation. All pairs included.
fullDescription:
Do light and night sound too similar? L & N Pro helps you practise hearing and saying the difference in English, Mandarin and Cantonese. All 59 word pairs are included from the first launch, with no in-app purchase or subscription.

LISTEN FIRST

Choose a word pair and a round of 3, 5 or 7 words. Tap what you heard in order, then check each answer. Tap a pair to hear both words back to back, or hold it to keep repeating until you tap Stop. Playback indicators keep the controls in place.

SAY ONE WORD

Listen to the model, record your attempt and see what the recognizer heard. Feedback explains the sound cues behind the result. Recording, scoring and retry controls stay in the same position. Short-word checks reject unrelated transcripts; if online recognition cannot identify a word, the app shows your waveform without guessing a pronunciation score.

REPLAY YOUR TAKES

Hear a saved recording on its own or after the model. History loads older attempts as you scroll. Recordings and practice history stay on your device, subject to available storage. Save failures are explained; clearing app data removes saved takes, and there is no cloud recording backup. Update in place to preserve your history.

SEE HOW THE SOUND WORKS

Explore a 3D cutaway of the tongue and airflow. Switch between English, Mandarin and Cantonese exercises, with a separate choice of English, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese or Cantonese for the interface. Audio examples use synthetic voices.

No account, ads or advertising trackers. Android word recognition needs internet access and your explicit permission. A new take is sent over HTTPS for transcription, then discarded from the service. Listening and lessons remain available without online recognition.

L & N Pro is a practice tool, not a clinical assessment. Its feedback and mouth model are learning aids, not a diagnosis or a measurement of your mouth.
